page_title: ATM 2-0 MAL | Atletico Madrid v Mallorca 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Victor Garcia is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.
90+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 2:0.
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Chiquinho (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Samu Costa.
90+1' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

88' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) produces a decent strike goalwards from the resulting set piece. His effort crashes against the crossbar and the ball stays out of the net. The goalkeeper was quite lucky!

87' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now. Samu Costa (Mallorca) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' The game is interrupted now, Samu Costa (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
85' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Jose Copete (Mallorca).
85' Jan Salas (Mallorca) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
82' Victor Garcia shows the yellow card to Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) for a heavy challenge.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Rodriguez departs the field of play to be replaced by Jan Salas (Mallorca).
81' Substitution. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) in, Sergi Darder out.
81' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Samuel Lino will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
81' Marcos Llorente will be replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
79' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar.
79' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
77' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), but it's just over the bar.
77' Corner kick. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity.
76' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is able to continue to play.
75' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
74' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
73' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' A substitution has been made. Koke goes off and Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
72' A yellow card for a tackle by Robert Navarro (Mallorca). Victor Garcia doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
71' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

71' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the set piece from long distance and tries to beat the goalkeeper with a projectile of a shot. Jan Oblak stops the ball from reaching the top of the net by deflecting it onto the bar. Great save! Good work from Mallorca as they win a corner.
70' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) will miss the next game.
70' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
67' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Mateu Morey Bauza is replaced by Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
67' That's the end of the game for Cyle Larin, who is replaced by Robert Navarro (Mallorca).
67' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Antoine Griezmann.
65' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
61' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) replaces Julian Alvarez.
61' Substitution. Giuliano Simeone makes his way off the pitch and Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
60' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempts a nice header from inside the penalty area, but his effort is blocked.
59' The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
59' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.
55' Koke (Atl. Madrid) tested Dominik Greif with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
55' The corner from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is cleared away by the defence.

55' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
54' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
51' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
49' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
46' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) who loops his header high over the bar.
46' The whistle blows and Victor Garcia starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' A brilliant individual effort! Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) tricks his way past challenges into the box and blazes his shot just a few inches over the top.
41' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
39' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.

39' Unbelievable! Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Dominik Greif pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.
35' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
32' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post.
31' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' 1 - 0 It's 1:0! Giuliano Simeone feeds Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
25' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
25' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
24' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
23' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
23' Atl. Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
21' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

20' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Dominik Greif is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
15' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
14' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
11' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Dominik Greif leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
10' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' Koke (Atl. Madrid) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
6' The Mallorca players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' A lofted cross from Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
1' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mallorca will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Victor Garcia will officiate today.
